diagram_math_checks.check: At k=0 the term is beta; at k=1 it is beta+alpha. Adjacent absent terms beta-alpha=(-1,2,-1), beta+2alpha=(2,-1,-1) are neither root nor zero. Thus endpoints are -p=0,q=1 and p-q=-1. Evaluation at h_alpha=diag(1,-1,0) gives beta(h_alpha)=-1.

k=-2,-1,0 gives -alpha,0,alpha. Outside this range scalar multiples have coefficient magnitude at least 2 and are not in the six-root list. Thus -p=-2,q=0 and p-q=2=alpha(h_alpha). Zero is marked by an open circle and described as a zero weight, not a root.
